video_title: Jaylen & Daniel Discuss The Struggles Of Early Stardom

quotes.speaker: Daniel Radcliffe
quotes.summary_phrase: Daniel Radcliffe on the pressure of being a child star
quotes.excerpt: The implication was always like, well you're fucked now, aren't you? What are you going to do after this?
quotes.quote: The thing I always say about Harry Potter and what it did for me in terms of towards the end of the films, I started getting, all of us started getting the question a lot from journalists of what are you going to do after this? The implication was always like, well you're fucked now, aren't you? What are you going to do after this? There's nothing left. And actually as I look back, I'm like, I can't believe people were saying that kind of stuff to a teenager. It's a really crazy thing to say to a young person.

quotes.speaker: Daniel Radcliffe
quotes.summary_phrase: Daniel Radcliffe on the struggle of finding one's identity while famous
quotes.excerpt: Part of growing up famous is that as you are trying to figure out who you are
quotes.quote: Part of growing up famous is that as you are trying to figure out who you are, you are getting this perceived version of yourself reflected back at you from a million places and a million people all the time. And so you have to figure out what of that is not real and what you actually are and what you actually want.

quotes.speaker: Daniel Radcliffe
quotes.summary_phrase: Daniel Radcliffe on directors who wanted to cast him after Harry Potter
quotes.excerpt: For every one of those directors there was, there was also a director that when, oh I would
quotes.quote: For every one of those directors there was, there was also a director that when, oh I would like him in my movie because I want to be the person that reinvents him or that can show an audience this actor that they think they know in a different light.

quotes.speaker: Jaylen Brown
quotes.summary_phrase: Jaylen Brown on the difficulty of making the NBA
quotes.excerpt: It's very hard to make it to the NBA. It's like you're in the 1% of the 1%.
quotes.quote: It's very hard to make it to the NBA. It's like you're in the 1% of the 1%. But in a very similar facet, you can be typecast where it's like you're just a basketball player. Throughout my career, I think I've done a good job of making sure that I've tried to not fight, but develop other aspects of me so people can see that I was more than just a basketball player.

quotes.speaker: Daniel Radcliffe
quotes.summary_phrase: Daniel Radcliffe on his dream of ruining a film set
quotes.excerpt: My dream is I dropped dead on a film set and I ruin someone's day.
quotes.quote: My dream is I dropped dead on a film set and I ruin someone's day. I'm going to screw up a day of shooting, because I've been lucky enough to do this to the very end.

quotes.speaker: Jaylen Brown
quotes.summary_phrase: Jaylen Brown on the short average career of NBA players
quotes.excerpt: The average for NBA players is four years, four and a half years.
quotes.quote: The average for NBA players is four years, four and a half years. And it's only getting younger and younger. So, I'm in my 10th season, so I'm already blessed to make it to where I'm at. I'm double the average. You never know when the ball can stop. It's not necessarily always up to you. You just got to make sure you stay in shape and stay in talent.

quotes.speaker: Jaylen Brown
quotes.summary_phrase: Jaylen Brown on developing identity outside of basketball
quotes.excerpt: If you wrap your identity in something and you're in the rug is kind of pulled up from
quotes.quote: That's why I think it's so important to develop other aspects of you along the way, because if you wrap your identity in something and you're in the rug is kind of pulled up from under you, then that could be like a mid-life crisis almost for someone. A lot of athletes deal with a lot of mental health. I work with the union, so I kind of help with the transition of being an NBA player into other aspects and developing that.

quotes.speaker: Daniel Radcliffe
quotes.summary_phrase: Daniel Radcliffe on his connection to Macaulay Culkin
quotes.excerpt: I have always felt a weird connection to Macaulay Culkin even though I've never met him.
quotes.quote: I have always felt a weird connection to Macaulay Culkin even though I've never met him, because Chris Columbus, who directed Harry Potter, also directed Home Alone. And he became the most famous kid in the world in the 90s, and they made, I guess they made three Home Alone movies. He made two Home Alone movies, and then he had to go out into the world and find other parts and find ways of continuing that.

quotes.speaker: Daniel Radcliffe
quotes.summary_phrase: Daniel Radcliffe on protecting child actors with financial laws
quotes.excerpt: I think there should be a law that says that you can't be held in a contract
quotes.quote: I think there should be a law that says that you can't be held in a contract that you signed as a minor when you are an adult. Because there's a lot of kids that sign, particularly for American TV, you'll have kids that will have, well their parents will sign them into things, and they won't be able to, they will mature into an adult and still be locked into something that somebody else signed for them.

quotes.speaker: Jaylen Brown
quotes.summary_phrase: Jaylen Brown on the lack of governance in NIL deals
quotes.excerpt: In basketball, have the NIL, it's a big emergence of name, image and likeness.
quotes.quote: In basketball, have the NIL, it's a big emergence of name, image and likeness. Because now kids can go to college and get paid. But what happens is there's no governance among our youth. So like an agent can sign a kid to like a 360 deal, and by the time he's 18, or he's still signed to this shitty deal or something like that. It happens, and we try to figure out ways to build parameters around it.

quotes.speaker: Jaylen Brown
quotes.summary_phrase: Jaylen Brown on the spiritual nature of basketball
quotes.excerpt: Entertainment is largely what is the most important thing in making money and revenue.
quotes.quote: Entertainment is largely what is the most important thing in making money and revenue, but it's also a very spiritual game. People feel connected to sports when they watch. They feel connected to their favorite players. It can bring people together, it can bring enemies together. So there's a power in sports that gets denounced in today's time because of analytics. Analytics have largely drove the game into a direction, but it denotes the connection that people have and the ability to bring people together.

quotes.speaker: Jaylen Brown
quotes.summary_phrase: Jaylen Brown on managing the mental health of being famous
quotes.excerpt: Things that I've done to help manage that is just be able like meditation.
quotes.quote: Things that I've done to help manage that is just be able like meditation. I love to travel, in order to like to kind of break my algorithm, see different things. Like I said, I love to learn and try different things. I have ADHD, I like master ADHD, I think at this point, where I do all these different activities, but it's also needed in order for my mental health to be stable enough to kind of deal with some of the things that come with your platform.
